package_absent.behavior: Addressables frontend remains discoverable and returns structured unsupported behavior when backend is unavailable.

acceptance: Human operator accepted the manual package-present/package-absent verification for Graph integration because GitHub Actions jobs were failing before runner steps started.
limitations: The formal Unity 6000.0.75f1 + Addressables 2.7.6 GitHub Actions lane could not be refreshed due runner-side failure.
This evidence verifies optional-package architecture behavior in the manually tested Unity environment rather than claiming that exact CI matrix combination executed.
